metadata.question: Does Dorsoidong Co Lake have a lighter blue color than Chibzhang Co Lake in October 12, 1987?

data.raw_code: This question is about comparing the color (likely reflectance) of two lakes on a specific date. I need to: 1. Identify the locations of Dorsoidong Co Lake and Chibzhang Co Lake 2. Get satellite imagery from October 12, 1987 3. Compare the blue reflectance values between the two lakes 4. Determine if Dorsoidong Co is "lighter blue" (higher blue reflectance) For 1987, I'll need to use Landsat 5 (operational from 1984-2013). I'll use the blue band (Band 1 for Landsat 5, ~0.45-0.52 μm). Strategy: - Define geometries for both lakes (I'll use approximate coordinates based on known Tibetan lake locations) - Get Landsat 5 imagery for October 12, 1987 - Mask clouds - Extract mean blue reflectance from each lake - Compare values Data quality checks: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Validate the reflectance values (should be between 0-1, not None/NaN) (C3) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions dorsoidong_co = ee.Geometry.Point([88.5, 34.2]) # Approximate coordinates for Dorsoidong Co chibzhang_co = ee.Geometry.Point([88.8, 34.0]) # Approximate coordinates for Chibzhang Co date = '1987-10-12' # 2. Data Acquisition collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([88.6, 34.1])) # Central point between lakes if collection.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No Landsat 5 images found for 1987-10-12.") print("C1") else: # Get the single image for that date image = collection.first() # Apply cloud masking (using QA_PIXEL band) qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL') cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)) # Cloud and cloud shadow image = image.updateMask(cloud_mask.Not()) # Scale to reflectance (Landsat L2 products are already scaled reflectance) blue_band = 'SR_B1' # Blue band for Landsat 5 # Extract blue reflectance for both lakes dorsoidong_blue = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dorsoidong_co.buffer(1000), # 1km buffer around lake scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(blue_band) chibzhang_blue = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=chibzhang_co.buffer(1000), # 1km buffer around lake scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(blue_band) dorsoidong_val = dorsoidong_blue.getInfo() chibzhang_val = chibzhang_blue.getInfo() # Check for valid pixels dorsoidong_count = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dorsoidong_co.buffer(1000), scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(blue_band).getInfo() chibzhang_count = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=chibzhang_co.buffer(1000), scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(blue_band).getInfo() print(f"Dorsoidong Co: {dorsoidong_val:.4f} (px: {dorsoidong_count})") print(f"Chibzhang Co: {chibzhang_val:.4f} (px: {chibzhang_count})") # Validation checks if dorsoidong_val is None or chibzhang_val is None: print("C3") elif dorsoidong_count == 0 or chibzhang_count == 0: print("C2") elif dorsoidong_val > chibzhang_val: # Higher reflectance = lighter blue print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
dorsoidong_co = ee.Geometry.Point([88.5, 34.2])  # Approximate coordinates for Dorsoidong Co
chibzhang_co = ee.Geometry.Point([88.8, 34.0])   # Approximate coordinates for Chibzhang Co
date = '1987-10-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([88.6, 34.1]))  # Central point between lakes

if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Landsat 5 images found for 1987-10-12.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the single image for that date
    image = collection.first()
    
    # Apply cloud masking (using QA_PIXEL band)
    qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4))  # Cloud and cloud shadow
    image = image.updateMask(cloud_mask.Not())
    
    # Scale to reflectance (Landsat L2 products are already scaled reflectance)
    blue_band = 'SR_B1'  # Blue band for Landsat 5
    
    # Extract blue reflectance for both lakes
    dorsoidong_blue = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=dorsoidong_co.buffer(1000),  # 1km buffer around lake
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(blue_band)
    
    chibzhang_blue = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=chibzhang_co.buffer(1000),  # 1km buffer around lake
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(blue_band)
    
    dorsoidong_val = dorsoidong_blue.getInfo()
    chibzhang_val = chibzhang_blue.getInfo()
    
    # Check for valid pixels
    dorsoidong_count = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=dorsoidong_co.buffer(1000),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(blue_band).getInfo()
    
    chibzhang_count = image.select(blue_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=chibzhang_co.buffer(1000),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(blue_band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"Dorsoidong Co: {dorsoidong_val:.4f} (px: {dorsoidong_count})")
    print(f"Chibzhang Co: {chibzhang_val:.4f} (px: {chibzhang_count})")
    
    # Validation checks
    if dorsoidong_val is None or chibzhang_val is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif dorsoidong_count == 0 or chibzhang_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif dorsoidong_val > chibzhang_val:  # Higher reflectance = lighter blue
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
